subject.title: fix(channels): honor configured read target policies

question: Should PR #99905 be accepted as the canonical channel read/action authorization boundary, including fail-closed behavior and Google Chat action-surface narrowing?
rationale: The PR fixes a security-sensitive boundary but deliberately changes runtime behavior that existing channel setups may observe, so automation cannot decide the product and upgrade tradeoff.

options.title: Refresh proof and land broad fix
options.body: Keep the signed turn-capability design, refresh exact-head live/CI proof, and merge after maintainer acceptance of the fail-closed and Google Chat changes.

options.title: Split Google Chat compatibility change
options.body: Land the shared authorization boundary separately and move Google Chat action-surface narrowing into a smaller compatibility-focused PR.

options.title: Pause for narrower boundary
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers reject the broad shared capability model and want a smaller per-channel fix instead.

recommendation.title: Refresh proof and land broad fix
recommendation.body: Keep the signed turn-capability design, refresh exact-head live/CI proof, and merge after maintainer acceptance of the fail-closed and Google Chat changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and own the current branch work needed to refresh proof or split compatibility-sensitive pieces.
